description: Department of Local Government - Western Province - Order made under Section 326 of Municipal Councils Ordinance (Chapter 252)
reasoning: This gazette contains an order made under specific legal ordinances and acts (Municipal Councils Ordinance Chapter 252 and Provincial Councils Act No. 12 of 1989). It establishes legal procedures and regulatory frameworks for financial control and utilization of Municipal Council Funds in Western Province. The content focuses on legal/regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
